The region open-ticket list now sorts high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10020).

I changed only the `ORDER BY` clause, using the same `CASE` expression as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters (region match, not closed) are unchanged.

`RegionManagerTest` and `TicketsPerRegionTest` pass offline with no output. No test calls the region list method directly, so I did not add a test for the T-1…T-5 ordering example. I did not commit.
